question: How must the ghee-smeared sacred thread be disposed of in the fire?
premises: The fire-consort formula must be uttered.
The object is smeared with ghee.
It must be cast into the fire.
inference: After uttering the fire-consort formula, one should cast the ghee-smeared thread into the fire.
uncertainties: The exact mantra referred to by vahnijāyāṃ is not spelled out.
plain_english: Having uttered the fire-consort formula, one should cast the ghee-smeared object into the fire.
